preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 2 <= n <= 200000 for n in [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin_text.splitlines()[1::2] if line.strip()])
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is an integer between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(a) == n and a[0] == 1 and len(set(a)) == n and all(1 <= x <= n for x in a) for a in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin_text.splitlines()[2::2] if line.strip()])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the sequence a has length n, starts with 1, contains distinct integers from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: sum([int(line.strip()) for line in stdin_text.splitlines()[1::2] if line.strip()]) <= 200000
preconditions.description: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(line), int) for line in stdout_text.strip().splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each line of output is a valid integer representing the minimum height.

postconditions.expression: all(h >= 0 for h in [int(line) for line in stdout_text.strip().splitlines()])
postconditions.description: The height for each test case is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(h == min_height(a) for h, a in zip([int(line) for line in stdout_text.strip().splitlines()], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin_text.splitlines()[2::2] if line.strip()]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output height equals the minimum possible height of a tree consistent with the given BFS order a, where children of each node are visited in ascending order.
